candidats.description: Ziwei Palace is a single eave structure, with the hip and gable roof covered with yellow glazed tiles. In the middle of the roof is a gem tower with two Chiweis on both ends. The upward turning eaves splitting into two seperate ridges with beastlike figures on top.

candidats.titre: File:Birmingham City University - Westbourne Road, Edgbaston - City South Campus - Lodge (7817027524).jpg
candidats.description: Going down Westbourne Road in Edgbaston. This is the City South Campus of Birmingham City University in Edgbaston. Also known as Westbourne Campus. I once went here when it was the UCE, in the previous building (when I was in my last years of Primary School for a day - can't recall why we went here though). Before the UCE, it was the Birmingham Polytechnic Campus in Edgbaston. Lodge near the University. Grade II listed. Lodge to City of Birmingham Polytechnic Men's Hostels, Birmingham WESTBOURNE ROAD 1. 5104 Edgbaston B15 Lodge to the City of Birmingham Polytechnic Men's Hostels SP 0585 NW 39/

candidats.description: Klein Noordijk estate: plastered square building with basement, two floors and an attic under a flat hipped roof coverde with muffled Old Dutch tiles. The centre bay of the front on the west side, facing the HW Iordensweg has a pointed gable extended just below the roof ridge and a gable roof with air springs with a profiled shelf, crowned by a gable sign. Nationally listed heritage.
